evidence: Contract decision scenarios, not live Orca cleanup proof

cases.input: An author's Dispatch is accepted while its PR remains open.
cases.expected: Retain its session and worktree for repairs.

cases.input: A reviewer's Dispatch is accepted and its evidence is durable.
cases.expected: Release its terminal, verify closure, and remove its worktree.

cases.input: A completed non-author worktree has uncommitted source and no protection hold.
cases.expected: Commit on a salvage ref, bundle, verify, then remove.

cases.input: The salvage bundle fails git bundle verify.
A completed worktree has an ignored file that is not a known build or dependency cache.
Native ownership confirms a genuine user_takeover terminal.
An author repair terminal is labelled user_takeover and the run record has its exact repair Dispatch ID.
cases.expected: Treat it as owned for settlement; otherwise hold.

cases.input: Orca is unreachable during driver-start sweep.
cases.expected: Report one line and continue; hold only host items.

cases.input: A worker release result is release_unknown but native inspection and fresh terminal list show it gone.
The run record lists a settled Axstack worktree in another repository.
cases.expected: Include it in sweep and remove when all guards pass.

cases.input: A settled worktree branch has a remote counterpart.
